text_block_list.text:
The Osaka Hai, the first leg of the Spring Senior Triple Crown.
Ahead of this legendary GⅠ grand stage—

Marvelous Sunday was in her usual spirits.
No, she was in a better mood than ever!
choice_data_list: More importantly, what on earth is that?!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Nfufu~ Isn't this amazing, Trainer?☆
Super, mega, sized!★☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
The mister at the shop gave me extra
and told me to do my best in the race!
It was super marvelous☆★
choice_data_list: The race is coming up, so don't overeat, okay...!
The race is coming up, so try not to eat too much, okay...!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
It's okay☆
Eating a lot makes your tummy feel nice and warm, right?
And when your tummy is warm, your heart feels warm tooっ★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
When cozy warmth meets piping heat,
it's surely, definitely the ultimate energy!!
We're gonna have a marvelous race☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: —Hey, Trainer, I'm gonna give it my all!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
First, let's put on an exceptionally
Marvelous race at this Osaka Hai!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Aaaand next, off to the Tenno Sho (Spring)
where those two are waiting☆★☆

During their New Year's shrine visit, Sakura Laurel and Mayano Top Gun promised to compete against each other in the Tenno Sho (Spring).
As for how the two of them are doing—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—And Sakura Laurel swings out to the far outside!
Sakura Laurel has taken the lead!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Sakura, Sakura, Sakura Laurel!
Leading the pack is Sakura Laurel—and she crosses the line!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
A brilliant graded race victory! The first cherry blossom of the New Year has bloomed!
Sakura Laurel takes a spectacular win!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
—Alright.
I'm fine. I can run...!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: I can still keep running...!!

Sakura Laurel claimed a graded stakes victory right at the start of the new year.
She ran strong after that as well, taking 1 win out of 2 graded stakes races, diligently polishing herself for the upcoming main event.

Furthermore, as for Mayano Top Gun,
in the recent Hanshin Daishoten—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for the cheers, everyone!
I'm gonna show you my sparkling run again today!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Don't you dare take your eyes off Maya, okay?☆
You copy?

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Eye copy!!

Highly lauded for her strong showings in last year's Kikuka Sho
and Arima Kinen, along with being chosen as Horse of the Year,
she claimed the spot of 1st favorite.
She had proven both in name and in deed that her genius talent had blossomed brilliantly.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Both Laurel and Mayano are training
harder and harder for the Tenno Sho (Spring)☆
They're getting so strong★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: The two's Marvelous is rising higher, and higher, and hiiigher! ☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Plus—♪
Yes—"in addition to that," indeed.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: —HAAAAH!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And Mayano Top Gun makes her move!
Before the 4th corner, taking the lead
is Mayano Top Gun! And right alongside her—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Brian! Narita Brian makes her move as well!
With 400 meters remaining, here comes the decisive moment!!
Hanshin Racecourse is shaking with deafening cheers!!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
You came... You really came, Brian-san!
But I'm just getting started!! Keep your eyes on me!!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I'm just getting started!!
I can sparkle... so much more than this!!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaaaahhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Like I'd let you...!
Uraaaahhhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
It's Brian, Brian!
Brian on the outside! Mayano Top Gun from the inside!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Brian takes the lead!
No, Mayano Top Gun fights back from the inside!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian, Mayano Top Gun!
Inside or outside—slightly on the outside!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Just on the outside! Narita Brian!!
The victory goes to Narita Brian!!"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"*pant, pant, pant*...!
Brian-san... That run just now was...!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Next up.
The Tenno Sho (Spring), was it?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Eh... Maya's next race?
Yeah, what about it—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I'm entering too.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I'll enter――and find out for myself.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Don't run away. Come at me.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Of cooooourse! There's no way I'm running away!
Next time... next time for sure, I will...!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
H-Hey! Narita Brian...
Didn't she just say she's entering the
Tenno Sho (Spring) next?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"I heard, I heard! Marvelous Sunday,
Mayano Top Gun, Sakura Laurel, and...
Narita Brian...!!"

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOOH! The Tenno Sho (Spring)
is gonna be totally insane, babyyyy!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
She's coming, she's coming, Brian is coming too!â
My prediction of a marvelous race is exploding!â

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Trainer!
Something amazing's gonna happen.
We're gonna do something amazing!!"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure we'll become the absolute most
Marvelous ever over there! ☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: No, no, not yet! I can't be floating on cloud nine just yet!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Mayano shone! Laurel bloomed!
Even Brian is growling with excitement!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: So of course, I'm going too!!
